test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following revolutionaries, who was arrested in Lahore conspiracy case by the British Government of India, was martyred in the hunger strike of 63 days in jail?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jatindra Nath Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jatindra Nath Das** was a revolutionary freedom fighter who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence.
 
• He was arrested in connection with the **Lahore Conspiracy Case** and imprisoned by the British government.
 
• While in **Lahore Central Jail**, Das undertook a hunger strike to protest against the inhu
